description: Flood, water extent and rainfall products: Pakistan is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: FL20220808PAK This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Satellite detected water in Sindh province, Pakistan as observed from a Sentinel-1 image acquired on 06 August 2022 at 06:25 local time. Within the analyzed area of about 59,000 km2, about 2,700 km2 of lands appear to be flooded. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal lists 52 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2023-10-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
